text: 下周关注丨10月CPI、PPI数据将公布，这些投资机会最靠谱 央行上调金融机构外汇存款准备金率，10只ETF新纳入港股通，成品油将迎来调价窗口......
text_en: Next week's focus: October CPI and PPI data to be released, these investment opportunities are the most reliable; PBOC raises the foreign exchange deposit reserve ratio for financial institutions, 10 ETFs newly included in Stock Connect, refined oil products to see a price adjustment window......
